description: Runs a program with secrets from the vault placed in its environment variables, without showing them to you. Give env values as kz:// references (plain strings are passed as they are). References look like "kz://<collection>/<item>/<field>" ("~" is the personal vault). Get them from search_items; never guess them. The command runs directly, not through a shell; for pipes or variable expansion use ["sh", "-c", "…"] and refer to the variable (e.g. "$DB_PASSWORD"). Secret values in the output are replaced with "<concealed by KeyZula>". Do not try to print or transform secrets to get around this.

cwd.description: Working directory (default: the server's current directory).

name: run_command
title: Run a command with secrets
